severities.label: Important
severities.description: Serious bug or weakness without immediate exploitation

releases.title: Stability, security & UX — crash fixes, accurate group counts, faster on old phones
releases.summary: Big round across all platforms: fixed a real-device iOS crash on group media, hardened security (Windows deps bumped past CVE-2023-5217, DB key never stored in plaintext, several pentest findings closed), made group member/online counts accurate and consistent across clients, auto-recovering and faster group/1:1 file transfers, full-length messages via chunking, Telegram-style single voice playback, camera-from-attach, and a performance pass that removes freezes on older Android phones. iOS via TestFlight (build 142852); Android and Desktop on the mirrors and GitHub.

changes.title: iOS — crash on sending/receiving group media fixed
changes.description: Sending a group photo or voice message, or retrying a photo, crashed on real devices (iPhone 16/17 Pro Max, iOS 26.6). Root cause: legacy group-file helpers queried the default (unencrypted) Realm, which became unmigratable after a schema bump and threw on every group file transfer. The default Realm config now self-heals. Confirmed fixed.

changes.title: Desktop (Windows) — bundled media/crypto libraries updated past known CVEs
changes.description: libvpx 1.11.0 → 1.14.0 (fixes CVE-2023-5217, a VP8 heap overflow), OpenSSL → 1.1.1w, FFmpeg → 4.4.5. The Windows cross-build was repaired end-to-end (libvpx mingw link, x264 build step, WinRT api-set false-positive) so these patched libraries actually ship.

changes.title: Security audit fixes (pentest findings closed)
changes.description: DB encryption key is no longer written to disk in plaintext — recovery uses a device-bound encrypted backup (NEW-3). Push-relay trusted-proxy handling so a client can't spoof its source IP (NEW-4). UnifiedPush URL validation tightened (NEW-1). Desktop image preview rejects decode-bombs and drops SVG (D-2). Filename/path-traversal hardening (D-3). NGC incoming-video bounds checks, ~30fps rate-limit and thread-safe peer map (D-4/5/6). Windows credential store NUL-terminates the user name (buffer over-read).

changes.title: iOS — sending video to a group fixed
changes.description: Videos picked for a group silently never sent: the file was copied on a background queue after the picker's temporary URL had already been deleted. The copy now happens synchronously while the URL is valid (photos were unaffected).

changes.title: Group member & online counts are now accurate and consistent
changes.description: Different clients showed different participant/online numbers for the same group. Both Android and iOS now read the counts straight from toxcore's NGC-synced group state (online peers incl. self + saved offline members), so clients converge on the same 'N members · M online'. The group-info screen and the in-group header also now agree.

changes.title: Group file transfers auto-recover (no more manual retry)
changes.description: A single dropped chunk left a group file stuck until the user tapped a retry circle. The receiver now re-requests missing chunks every few seconds (parity with iOS) instead of once per 30s, so transfers self-heal.

changes.title: Long messages send in full instead of being truncated
changes.description: Messages over ~1.3 KB were silently cut off. Long messages to an online friend are now split into chunks and reassembled on the other side; Saved Messages keep the full text. Pasting a very long message no longer freezes the input either.

changes.title: iOS — private (in-group direct) messages are surfaced
changes.description: A private message sent to you inside a group used to land silently with no alert. It now notifies like any message, titled '🔒 <sender> (private)', so you can tell it was addressed to you personally.

changes.title: Android — no more freezes on older phones
changes.description: Switching tabs/groups and opening busy chats could freeze the UI. Chat history now loads off the UI thread (1:1 and groups); per-row work in the chat/group lists (member counts, unread badges, icon drawables) is cached. Noticeably smoother on low-end devices.

changes.title: 1:1 files are accepted automatically
changes.description: Incoming files in a direct chat no longer show an accept/decline prompt — they download immediately, in both directions.

changes.title: Voice messages — only one plays at a time
changes.description: Starting a voice message now pauses whichever one was playing (Telegram-style), in both 1:1 and group chats.

changes.title: Message a group member privately
changes.description: Tapping a member opens their info with a clear 'Send private message' field and button (previously a hidden debug field that only sent on exit).

changes.title: Camera straight from the attach button
changes.description: The attach (paperclip) action now offers Camera (photo) / Record video / Gallery, so you can shoot and send media without leaving the chat.

changes.title: Send time shown for media in private/saved chats
changes.description: Voice messages, photos and videos in 1:1 and Saved Messages now show their send time, like text messages.

changes.title: Add-contact screen — Android-style on iOS, 'Paste ID' hint
changes.description: The iOS add-contact page now matches Android: 'Paste ID' field, 'Scan QR code' and a new 'Scan QR code from gallery' (decode a saved photo), plus a help line. Android ID hint renamed to 'Вставьте ID'.

changes.title: Connection-type diagnostic for group peers
changes.description: A peer's info now shows whether you reach them directly (UDP) or via a relay (TCP) — helpful for understanding transfer speed.

changes.title: Bootstrap from public Tox DHT nodes
changes.description: Both Android and iOS now bootstrap from the proven public Tox DHT (tox.abilinski.com, mf-net.eu, tox.initramfs.io, …) instead of self-hosted bootstrap nodes, so joining no longer depends on our own infra being reachable. The push.khandaq.org wake relay (FCM/APNs) is a separate role and is unchanged.

releases.title: Android UX polish — chat media, favorites, profile tab
releases.summary: Android v0.2.7 (build 10299): Telegram-style media/file bubbles in groups, favorites tab fix, profile avatar on bottom nav, navigation and drawer cleanup. Desktop builds refreshed on mirrors. iOS unchanged — use TestFlight build 142825.

changes.title: Android — group media bubbles (Telegram-style)
changes.description: Removed thick green/blue containers around photos, videos and files in group chats. Images and videos render edge-to-edge with rounded corners; videos show play overlay and size label on the thumbnail; documents use a compact single-row card.

changes.title: Android — Favorites tab shows only pinned chats
changes.description: Adding one contact or group to Favorites no longer pulls unrelated chats into the tab after background connection updates.

changes.title: iOS — add contact screen crash fix
changes.description: Contact ID field visible again; app no longer crashes on input (iOS 26 placeholder fix). Available on TestFlight build 142825.

changes.title: iOS — private chat input and video send
changes.description: Text input no longer blocks after autocorrect/emoji; message text not cleared before send confirmation; video compression moved off main thread.

changes.title: Android — profile photo on Profile tab
changes.description: Bottom navigation Profile tab shows your real avatar (like Telegram), with connection dot on top; falls back to default icon when no photo is set.

changes.title: Android — four-tab navigation and cleaner menu
changes.description: Contacts, Chats, Settings and Profile open directly without extra screens. Removed Close app and Connect/Disconnect from the drawer; connection is automatic.

changes.title: Android — group chat stability and attachments
changes.description: Lock/unlock no longer drops you from a group; history loads immediately; photos and videos send via paperclip; participant names and avatars from contacts.

changes.title: Android — contacts and ID UX
changes.description: QR scan from gallery when adding a contact; add yourself to contacts (saved messages); UI uses ID instead of Tox ID/My ID; Tox ID 64/76 normalization.

changes.title: Android — themes, status, and notifications
changes.description: Readable dark/light themes; delivery/read checkmarks; human-readable online status; notifications when chat is open; push settings removed from UI (off by default).

changes.title: Android — Khandaq Community and rebrand cleanup
changes.description: No auto-join to test group; TRIfA Community renamed to Khandaq Community; old TRIfA profile names migrate to Khandaq; crash screen and strings updated.

changes.title: iOS — Khandaq rebrand and TestFlight
changes.description: Bundle org.khandaq.messenger, Khandaq branding, Khandaq Community menu entry, bootstrap list update. Public beta via TestFlight.

changes.title: Desktop — Linux↔macOS message delivery
changes.description: Outgoing delivery indicators clear correctly; cross-platform replies work. Always-dark Khandaq theme on Windows.

changes.title: Network — bootstrap and reconnect
changes.description: Updated bootstrap node lists; faster reconnect after Wi‑Fi, cellular or VPN changes on mobile and desktop.

changes.title: Android — media send preview
changes.description: Photo and video picks show a confirmation preview with cancel before upload.

changes.title: Android — localization and NGC settings text
changes.description: Remaining hardcoded toasts moved to string resources; group chat (NGC) preference description clarified.

changes.title: Release v0.2.7 mirrors
changes.description: Fresh Android APK (10299), desktop installers and checksums on khandaq.org and GitHub Releases.

releases.title: Cross-platform messaging and UX stabilization
releases.summary: Fix Linux↔macOS desktop delivery spinners, Android avatars/themes/media UX, iOS video send and presence, network hardening, and v0.2.6 release builds on khandaq.org and GitHub Releases.

changes.title: Desktop Linux↔macOS messages stuck on spinner
changes.description: Messages arrived but delivery indicators never cleared; macOS replies did not reach Linux. Outgoing traffic now uses Tox core only; toxext negotiation and receipt handling fixed.

changes.title: Android empty avatars in chat list
changes.description: Friend list showed blank circles instead of avatars or initials. Glide cache cleared before placeholders; explicit avatar dimensions applied.

changes.title: iOS crash when sending video
changes.description: Video send ran on main thread with full-file memory load. Compression and upload moved to background with size limits and error UI.

changes.title: Android text messages blocked after emoji
changes.description: After sending emoji-only messages, text sends hung with spinner in DM and groups. Message pipeline state fixed.

changes.title: Cross-platform friend request mismatch
changes.description: Desktop required manual accept while Android auto-accepted, leaving contacts stuck in pending. Auto-accept aligned on all desktop clients.

changes.title: Android dark theme unreadable chat text
changes.description: Message bubbles, timestamps, date separators and input field used dark text on dark backgrounds in night mode. Theme colors corrected.

changes.title: Android invisible toolbar icons in light theme
changes.description: Add-friend and hamburger menu used white icons on white header. Switched to DayNight ActionBar with adaptive tints.

changes.title: Network reconnection and bootstrap hardening
changes.description: Long reconnect delays after WiFi/cellular/VPN changes and weak offline startup. Bootstrap refresh, backoff with jitter, and connectivity monitors added on mobile and desktop.

changes.title: Remove Tox identicon avatars
changes.description: Generated Tox ID icons replaced with initials placeholders everywhere; profile ID badge section removed.

changes.title: Media send preview before upload
changes.description: Gallery picks sent immediately without confirmation. Preview screen with caption and cancel added on Android and iOS.

changes.title: Telegram-style online status text
changes.description: Colored debug dots replaced with readable presence strings in chat lists.

changes.title: Remove Khandaq Community auto-group
changes.description: Built-in public group entry and auto-join removed from Android client.

changes.title: Linux .deb deploy mirror 404
changes.description: Site deploy copied only unversioned .deb and picked stale 0.2.5 package. Deploy script now uploads latest .deb with versioned filename.

changes.title: Message delivery checkmarks
changes.description: Outgoing messages show sending/sent/delivered/read indicators in chats.

changes.title: Site and README download links v0.2.6
changes.description: Landing page, README, and mirror checksums updated to match GitHub Release v0.2.6.

releases.title: Security audit remediation
releases.summary: 16 vulnerabilities from the external security audit fixed in code. v0.2.5 builds for Android, iOS, Desktop, and an updated push relay.

changes.title: Android unlock crash after password
changes.description: The unlock screen silently blocked login due to isPasswordValid(). Validation now works correctly and errors are shown in the UI.

changes.title: Push token hijack via exported receiver
changes.description: Any app could replace the FCM token via broadcast. Receiver is now closed (exported=false); token is applied only from inside the app.

changes.title: IP leak via automatic OpenStreetMap tile load
changes.description: Incoming location messages automatically requested tile.openstreetmap.org. Map tiles load only after an explicit user tap.

changes.title: iOS buffer over-read in push packet
changes.description: Lossless packets without a null terminator caused over-read and crash. Strings are read via initWithBytes:length: with explicit length.

changes.title: iOS path traversal when saving files from contacts
changes.description: Filenames like ../../Library/evil could escape the downloads directory. Uses lastPathComponent and filters .. segments.

changes.title: Android IOCipherContentProvider path traversal
changes.description: A neighbouring app could read foreign files via content:// paths with ... Provider is closed; unsafe paths are rejected.

changes.title: Command injection in bootstrap scripts
changes.description: A malicious host in the registry could run arbitrary commands. Host validation added; bash -c removed; ssh uses -- separator.

changes.title: Open push wake endpoint and flood
changes.description: Anyone could send wake requests to push.khandaq.org. Rate limits added, optional HMAC auth, proper codes on FCM timeout.

changes.title: Weak Android database encryption key storage
changes.description: DB key was stored in plaintext in SharedPreferences. Skip mode uses Android Keystore; new passwords use PBKDF2 + salt.

changes.title: Weak push URL whitelist
changes.description: A contact could supply a push URL to a third-party server (ntfy.sh, etc.). Only push.khandaq.org and tox.zoff.xyz are accepted.

changes.title: Desktop hang on long markdown messages
changes.description: Messages 20k+ with unclosed ``` blocks froze the UI. Markdown limited to 16k; multiline code blocks to 8k.

changes.title: Bootstrap nodes imported without validation
changes.description: Arbitrary JSON with invalid hosts could enter the database. BootstrapHostValidator added on import.

changes.title: nginx rate limit missing on push endpoint
changes.description: Flooding push.khandaq.org was not limited at nginx level. limit_req and limit_conn added.

changes.title: Predictable nospam on registration
changes.description: nospam was generated with a weak PRNG. Replaced with SecureRandom.

changes.title: Unpinned toxcore in bootstrap Docker image
changes.description: Bootstrap build could pull an arbitrary toxcore revision. Pinned to TOXCORE_TAG=v0.2.20.

changes.title: iOS KhandaqPush incompatible with iOS 12
changes.description: CryptoKit required iOS 13+, breaking TestFlight builds. HMAC moved to CommonCrypto.
